notes: Inbound: self-serve signup 2026-03-05; used free credits to evaluate chat and moderation endpoints.
Primary contacts: Emma Kline (Product Lead), Rakesh Singh (Eng Lead). Small dev team, teacher-facing product for K-6.
Use-case summary: real-time classroom copilot to help teachers with prompts and generate quizzes; batch moderation for student uploads; auto-summarization of class notes.
Budget: very cost-sensitive; target ~= $0.02 per active student per month beyond credits. Looking for obvious savings (batching, smaller-model fallbacks).
Preference: open/quantized models are acceptable if accuracy holds; want ability to route student traffic to lowest-cost compatible variant first.
Latency/Throughput targets: short-turn chat 200-400ms p95 for single-turn teacher queries; peak throughput ~50 qps during class windows; embeddings workload is smaller and can be batched.
Security: require SSO (SAML) for teacher/admin accounts, SOC2 evidence for vendor, per-request audit logs. KMS optional in future phases.
Moderation notes: conservative moderation desired but leaders worry about false positives blocking homework. Request: confidence scores and explainability for flagged items.
POC plan: 2-week hosted API POC. Goals: run moderation on 10k recent submissions, validate cost using Redwood Optimize recommendations, test fallback routing for non-critical prompts.
Demo held 2026-03-10 w/ Alyssa Chen (SE): walked through rate limits, streaming, and cost dashboard. Showed how batching + prefix cache could reduce token costs (~30-45% estimate).
Requested artifacts: short security FAQ (SOC2 evidence), sample moderation prompt set for K-12, simple cost estimator for 1k/10k/50k MAUs.
Quote from Emma: 'We need moderation that errs on the safe side but doesn’t flag every stray phrase from students.'
Next: provide trial keys, enable SSO sandbox, deliver cost estimate and sample prompt set by 2026-03-15. Internal procurement gate on 2026-03-20.
Blockers: procurement approval, need SOC2 evidence, SSO scheduling (engineering bandwidth), explicit cost per student ceiling.
